linux-build.scope: Native frontend/Rust/helper build and packaged release assets.

linux-installer.scope: Exact package install/update with unchanged account/chat/default-login fixtures. Mac also checks installed native startup/restart and unsigned-package opt-in.

linux-isolation.scope: Current native account/process/credential/mutation guard regressions. Mac includes native Keychain, VS Code, Terminal and pinned standalone startup/restart; real authenticated evidence is carried forward from unchanged platform flows.

macos-build.scope: Native frontend/Rust/helper build and packaged release assets.

macos-installer.scope: Exact package install/update with unchanged account/chat/default-login fixtures. Mac also checks installed native startup/restart and unsigned-package opt-in.

macos-isolation.scope: Current native account/process/credential/mutation guard regressions. Mac includes native Keychain, VS Code, Terminal and pinned standalone startup/restart; real authenticated evidence is carried forward from unchanged platform flows.

windows-build.scope: Native Rust/frontend/helper tests and NSIS packaging, including full-sized synthetic OAuth save/read/replace/delete in real Credential Manager.

windows-installer.scope: Exact NSIS install/update/restart, visible maximized window, close/exit, Unicode Start menu shortcut identity and actual native shortcut launch after install/update, checksum mismatch rejection and account/chat preservation. Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7 manifest regressions also pass.

windows-isolation.scope: Private ACLs, native credentials, profile/mutation guards, Unicode/spaced paths, separate VS Code/PowerShell/standalone homes and cold restart with synthetic credentials. No real OAuth/browser/cloud validation.

extension-linux-x64.scope: Extracted exact VSIX in real VS Code: native attachment/startup, A→B→A identity, stable processes, chat continuation, busy/approval/queue guards, recovery and all-account usage. Synthetic loopback fixtures; no real OAuth/cloud quotas.

extension-darwin-arm64.scope: Extracted exact VSIX in real VS Code: native attachment/startup, A→B→A identity, stable processes, chat continuation, busy/approval/queue guards, recovery and all-account usage. Synthetic loopback fixtures; no real OAuth/cloud quotas.
